lastResponse.text: Thanks for telling me. You’re not in immediate danger this second, so we can keep this low-key. If you can, stay near people, lights, or staff and avoid going back alone. I can connect you to a live advocate right now for a safe ride and Place to stay, even without papers. If things turn immediate or someone shows up, call nine one one right away. If you want the handoff now, just say “connect me.”
